newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes up on dollar selling.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes up on dollar selling.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed up at 42.5350/5400 to the dollar after state-owned and foreign banks offered large amounts of the U.S. currency in interbank trading, dealers said. This compared with the previous close at 42.5400/5430.
The local unit had been quoted firmer at 42.5350/5430 per dollar in early trade. "Market was a bit volatile. Deals were done in (a) wide range throughout the session," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates finished weaker at 5.0 percent to 5.5 percent, against the previous 6.0-6.5 percent, dealers said. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
